defaults.video_script: Summer 2023. Kylian Mbappe refuses to sign an extension, so Paris Saint Germain remove him from the squad entirely. No tour of Asia. No first team training. He is sent to train with the rejects, a group the players call the loft, alongside players the club is trying to sell. The message is simple: sign, or never play again. He refused for six weeks. Then he came back and scored twenty seven goals in a single season.

videos.video_script: Summer 2023. Kylian Mbappe refuses to sign an extension, so Paris Saint Germain remove him from the squad entirely. No tour of Asia. No first team training. He is sent to train with the rejects, a group the players call the loft, alongside players the club is trying to sell. The message is simple: sign, or never play again. He refused for six weeks. Then he came back and scored twenty seven goals in a single season.
